design_purpose.max_rise_m: A visible retained bank, at most two metres higher than published terrain.
design_purpose.second_max_rise_m: Excited Uplands gains stone shelves up to three metres high, tapered into ordinary steps around protected space.
design_purpose.second_ridge_spacing_m: Twelve metres between parallel shelf patterns leaves walking troughs and distinct exploration approaches; no heat hazard is implied.
design_purpose.blend_m: Taper the bank around its edge and protected ground; ordinary old steps stay ordinary.
design_purpose.ownership_margin_m: Keep three metres of working and walking space around current builds, machinery, excavations and recoverables.
design_purpose.resource_margin_m: Keep existing finite resource ground and two metres of harvesting space unchanged.
design_purpose.minimum_changed_columns: Defer a fully occupied envelope rather than publish a token or destructive event.
design_purpose.ore_spacing_m: Leave working room between each region's four exposed deposits and its one finite host workplace.
design_purpose.ore_nodes: Two copper/tin pairs in Retained Fen, or two iron/silver pairs in Excited Uplands, make each changed habitat useful without an infinite supply.
design_purpose.ore_units: Each new deposit holds eight ore, retaining existing cold iron work and charcoal heating for copper, tin and silver.
design_purpose.safe_return_radius_m: Defer publication while an overworld enemy is fighting within twenty-four metres of the return point.
